description: Rank live Hyperliquid perpetual markets by funding rate, funding APR, open interest, 24h volume or 24h change. Covers every listed perp including HIP-3 builder markets. Default: the 25 markets with the most extreme funding APR, concise fields. Ask for `limit`, `sort`, `coins` or DETAILED only when you need them — the full set is ~13k tokens. Result carries `provenance` (upstream endpoint, request, fetch time).

coins.description: Restrict to symbols, e.g. ["BTC","ETH"]. No -PERP suffix.

dir.description: Direction; `asc` on fundingAprPct surfaces the most negative funding first.

response_format.description: CONCISE (default): coin, mark, fundingAprPct, oi, vol. DETAILED: every field.

sort.description: Ranking key. Funding, premium and change sort by magnitude by default.

name: tape_markets_radar
title: Hyperliquid Markets Radar
